response.sql: WITH type_avg AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price, o.overall_avg FROM type_avg t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND t.avg_price > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS mean_kept FROM kept), final AS (SELECT k.production_type_code, k.avg_price, k.overall_avg, m.mean_kept FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.avg_price > m.mean_kept) SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_type_average_price, AVG(avg_price - overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall_average, AVG(avg_price - mean_kept) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM final
